files.name: motion-prompt-002.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Stagger" (スタガー), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #002

What it is: Items appear one after another, slightly offset in time
What the sample shows: Chart bars rise one after another from the left, each slightly delayed.
Spec:
- One pass per 2.35 s. Seven bars (width 44, gap 20, heights 52, 84, 68, 112, 92, 136, 158), coloured blue, coral, yellow, mint in rotation.
- Bar i (0-based) starts at 0.15 + 0.12·i s and grows from 0 to full height in 0.5 s with backOut (s = 2.6), anchored at the baseline, overshooting and settling.
- White dot (radius 6.5, 16 px above the bar top): starts 0.34 s after its bar with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(16t).
- Exit: bars shrink with cubic ease-in over 0.26 s starting at 1.78 + 0.045·i s; dots vanish first, over 0.2 s from 1.70 + 0.045·i s.
When to use it: Use it to bring in several items (list rows, chart bars, cards) in sequence and lead the eye across them.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/002.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
